items.title: Editor closes when opening a very large workspace file
items.body: Synthetic example: on DemoOS 4, opening a workspace file larger than 200 MB closes the editor. The behavior repeats with extensions disabled. Expected: show the file or a size warning without terminating the editor.

items.title: Large project file causes the editor process to exit
items.body: Synthetic example: loading a 250 MB generated project file makes the editor process exit on DemoOS 4. Extensions are disabled. Expected: keep running and explain any supported file-size limit.

items.title: Add a shortcut for switching review panels
items.body: Synthetic example: please add a configurable keyboard shortcut that cycles between the review panels. The action should appear in the command palette and remain accessible to screen readers.

items.title: How can I change the demo cache location?
items.body: Synthetic example: I cannot find the setting that changes the demo cache directory. Is this currently configurable, and which configuration key should I use?
